direction: 毛笔书写，逆转左右舒展，减少板正的结构，黑金朱红保留

variants.name: 左右舒展
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand, SUBSTANTIAL TYPOGRAPHIC REDESIGN of attached project draft.
The user says the draft is much too rigid and square. Their priority is genuinely free, uninhibited Chinese brush handwriting, especially "逆转", with energy opening freely to BOTH LEFT AND RIGHT.
Use attachment only for BLACK / OLD GOLD / small DARK RED palette and the idea of a larger upper 逆转 with smaller 五丈原 below. DO NOT preserve the attached 逆转 letter contours. ERASE and REWRITE the upper pair completely in new expressive handwritten running-script calligraphy. Remove all artificial triangle-serifs, identical pointed corners, blocky black shapes and symmetrical badge architecture. No tight emblem, shield, V composition or exact straight baseline. The new silhouette must be visibly different from the attached blocklike version.
Exact text ONLY: upper "逆转", lower "五丈原". All five correct simplified Chinese characters, readable, no pseudo-characters. Genuine brush physics: press with the belly of the brush for full deep strokes, lift into hairlines, turn with flowing wrists, bristles split naturally in fast dry strokes, edges vary from wet-soft to dry-feathered. Thick-to-thin variation should be dramatic. The characters must feel spontaneously WRITTEN in a confident handful of gestures, not a geometric font with grunge painted on.
Make the top pair spread wider than the lower line, with expressive lateral space. The left side of 逆 opens left through its initial strokes and the travel of its 辶, while the outer strokes of 转 have generous movement to the right, maintaining its correct 车 + 专 skeleton. Each gets its own free gesture, not one giant detached underline. Keep organic uneven character height and tilt, no mirrored wings. Actual character strokes form the gestures, no decorative swooshes added.
Upper pair predominantly ink-black with a FEW irregular aged-gold pigment streaks; tiny vermilion on selected final brush tips only. Lower 五丈原 warm matte old gold with a little black dry grain and muted red tips; rewrite it more naturally too, quieter and steadier but still BRUSH-WRITTEN, no carved metal, no uniform thickness. No hammered gold grain or regular metallic micro-pattern. Mostly flat ink / mineral pigment / scattered fine gold powder. No bevel, no thick outline, no cast shadow.
One isolated logo, genuinely transparent background, comfortable 10% margin so every long tip is intact. Overall roughly 1.8:1, lower line around 70-80% of top pair's total expressive span. Lower line clearly legible and substantial. No background, frame, English, seal, tagline, duplicate text, scene, weapon, spark, huge ink splash or watermark. Direction 01: airy expansive lyrical running-script. Two upper characters breathe through large open counters and sharply changing stroke widths. 逆's initial side strokes reach distinctly left, its lower 辶 travels broadly then lifts into a slim curve. 转's upper horizontal strokes extend decisively to the right and finish in delicate dry-brush tips. Upper top contour rises and falls gently, left character slightly lower than right. Rich black expressive main strokes with very sparse gold, and a short red-gold finish at the lower-left-to-center sweep. Warm gold 五丈原 sits beneath the center with a slightly irregular natural baseline. Elegant, uninhibited, cinematic, visibly organic handwritten silhouette.
